verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide documents the OAuth device authorization grant for clients that have limited input or lack a browser. The OIDC layers reference documents a dedicated /auth/device endpoint that issues device and user codes, which lets CLIs and headless agents sign in without embedding long-lived secrets. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of device-flow use with CLIs or agents, and documentation of the token polling and user-approval steps in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can authenticate CLIs and headless agents via the OAuth device authorization flow instead of pasting long-lived secrets

citations.quote: This is used by clients running on internet-connected devices that have limited input capabilities or lack a suitable browser.
/realms/{realm-name}/protocol/openid-connect/auth/device ... used to obtain a device code and a user code.
